title: Crisis Management
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Los verdaderos líderes se forjan en las crisis. Ahora tienes el vocabulario para tomar el control cuando las cosas van mal.

parts.visual:
Enfrentando el problema: 
- Damage control (Control de daños - minimizar consecuencias). 
- Tackle a problem (Abordar/enfrentar un problema directamente). 
- Mitigate risks (Mitigar riesgos - reducir la gravedad). 
Ej: We need to do damage control immediately to mitigate the risks.
parts.audio: Facing the problem. Damage control means minimizing the negative consequences. Tackle a problem means to deal with it directly and aggressively. Mitigate risks means to reduce the severity or probability of a risk. For example: We need to do damage control immediately to mitigate the risks.

parts.visual:
Resolución y resultados: 
- Root cause (La causa raíz / el origen del problema). 
- Contingency plan (Plan de contingencia / Plan B). 
- Bounce back (Recuperarse de un fracaso o crisis). 
Ej: If we find the root cause, we can bounce back. We also need a contingency plan.
parts.audio: Resolution and results. The root cause is the fundamental origin of a problem. A contingency plan is your Plan B. Bounce back means to recover quickly from a failure or crisis. For example: If we find the root cause, we can bounce back. We also need a contingency plan.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de manejo de crisis adecuada.

questions.question: After the PR scandal, the company had to do some serious ____ control. (Control de daños).
We need to ____ the problem before it gets worse. (Abordar/Atacar directamente).
questions.explanation: Tackle a problem = abordar/atacar un problema.

questions.question: To ____ the risks, we should diversify our investments. (Mitigar / Reducir).
We are just treating the symptoms. We need to find the ____ cause. (Causa raíz).
questions.explanation: Root cause = causa raíz / origen del problema.

questions.question: If the main server fails, what is our ____ plan? (Plan de contingencia).
questions.explanation: Contingency plan = plan de contingencia (plan B).

questions.question: Despite the crisis last year, the company managed to ____ back and increase profits. (Recuperarse).
questions.explanation: Bounce back = recuperarse (rebotar) después de una caída.

questions.question: The situation is ____ out of control. We need the CEO here now. (Saliéndose / Girando).
questions.explanation: Spinning out of control = saliéndose de control vertiginosamente.

questions.question: They had to lay off 500 employees as a last ____. (Último recurso).
questions.explanation: As a last resort = como último recurso.

questions.question: We need to nip this problem in the ____ before it becomes a disaster. (Cortar de raíz / en el capullo).
questions.explanation: Nip in the bud = cortar de raíz (antes de que crezca).

questions.question: There is a ____ in the system that allows hackers to enter. (Falla / Brecha).
questions.explanation: Flaw = falla, defecto o brecha de seguridad.

questions.question: The CEO had to ____ the music and apologize to the shareholders. (Enfrentar las consecuencias).
questions.explanation: Face the music = enfrentar las consecuencias de un error.

questions.question: We must ensure business ____ during the power outage. (Continuidad).
Let's brainstorm to find a ____ to this crisis. (Solución alterna / Parche).
questions.explanation: Workaround = solución temporal, alternativa para evadir el problema.

questions.question: The recall of the defective cars was a PR ____. (Pesadilla).
questions.explanation: PR nightmare = pesadilla de relaciones públicas.

questions.question: We need someone to take ____ of this situation immediately. (Tomar el mando/cargo).
questions.explanation: Take charge = tomar el mando, asumir la responsabilidad.

questions.question: The problem escalated ____. (Rápidamente).
To avoid bankruptcy, they had to take ____ measures. (Drásticas).
Don't panic. Keep your ____ and think logically. (Mantén la calma / cabeza).
questions.explanation: Keep your head = mantener la calma (no perder la cabeza).

questions.question: We are walking on thin ____ with these legal issues. (Caminando sobre hielo fino / Situación arriesgada).
questions.explanation: Walk on thin ice = estar en una situación muy precaria o arriesgada.

questions.question: It's time to trigger the ____ plan. (Desencadenar / Activar).
questions.explanation: Trigger a plan = activar o desencadenar un plan.

A ____ plan. (Plan de contingencia con C)

____ the music. (Enfrentar la situación con F)
Business ____. (Continuidad con C)
